# `sqlTaggedRowTypeToSqlSchema`

Suggests SqlSchema instead of an explicit row type argument on Effect's sql tagged template

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Effect-native |
| Default severity | `off` |
| Fixable | No |
| Effect versions | v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377224` |
| Language Service name | `sqlTaggedRowTypeToSqlSchema` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/sql-tagged-row-type-to-sql-schema` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Effect } from "effect"
import { SqlClient } from "effect/sql"

interface CommandRow {
  readonly command_id: string
}

export const program = Effect.gen(function*() {
  const sql = yield* SqlClient.SqlClient
  return yield* sql<CommandRow>`SELECT command_id FROM commands`
/**
                ^^^ effecttsgo(sql-tagged-row-type-to-sql-schema): The sql tagged template only asserts its row type CommandRow and does not validate it at runtime; use SqlSchema (findAll, findOne, findOneOption, findNonEmpty, void) with a Schema for Result to decode rows.
*/
})
```

        }
      }

}
